physics: MCsquare e0404: Class II condensed history, ICRU-63-type nuclear cross sections; nuclear interactions and secondary protons/deuterons/alphas enabled; E_Cut_Pro 0.5 MeV, D_Max 0.2 cm, Epsilon_Max 0.25
source: Single spot, nominal 150 MeV (BDL_mono.txt: MeanEnergy 150, EnergySpread 0 %, spot size 0.001 mm, divergence 1e-6 rad, correlation 0, Weight1 1), gantry 0, couch 0, spot (0,0), meterset 1 x ProtonsMU 1e9. Isocentre (60,150,60) mm = CT centre, as in the working registered smoke bundle. In the MCsquare source (src/compute_beam_model.c, BEV_to_CT_frame) IsocenterPosition is in mm in the CT frame measured from the CT origin; beam-frame z maps to CT y so depth is along y; the sense (+y or -y) is not certain from the source, so the beam enters at y=0 or y=300 mm and the depth axis may be reversed in Dose.mhd: determine from the dose peak. Previous isocentre (60,0,60) put all primaries outside the geometry.
geometry: CT 60 x 150 x 60 voxels, 2 mm spacing (120 x 300 x 120 mm; MCsquare axes x,y,z with depth along y), all voxels HU 0; dose grid = CT grid (Independent_scoring_grid False)
materials: HU 0 -> Water_Phantom scanner conversion of the registered MCsquare (HU_Density/HU_Material files)
cuts: E_Cut_Pro 0.5 MeV, D_Max 0.2 cm, Epsilon_Max 0.25, Te_Min 0.05 MeV
scorers: LET_MHD_Output True, LET method left at the MCsquare default (StopPow)
units: MetaImage float32 little-endian, dimension order x,y,z (x fastest), 2 mm spacing: Dose in Gy for meterset weight 1 x ProtonsMU (1e9 protons; divide by 1e9 for Gy per primary - confirm with output); LET in MeV/cm per MCsquare documentation of StopPow method (confirm in log)
rationale: independent Monte Carlo evidence for suite S-PHYS-PROTON-EM/-NUCLEAR/-LET
